import pathlib, subprocess, json, hashlib
repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
out = pathlib.Path('/tmp/kk-review-isolated.aRBae2')

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args])
base = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
release = git('rev-parse', 'eval-release"'^{commit}'"').decode().strip()
criteria = [str(plugin / 'skills/review-code' / f) for f in ['functional-review.md','shared-change-context.md','shared-review-scope-protocol.md','shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']]
criteria += [str(plugin / 'profiles/python/review-code' / f) for f in ['security-checklist.md','solid-checklist.md','code-quality-checklist.md','removal-plan.md']]
assert len(criteria) == len(set(criteria)) == 8
assert all(pathlib.Path(f).is_file() for f in criteria)
provenance=[]
candidate=[]
historical=[]
context=[]
def materialize(selector, original, category, destination):
    data=git('show', selector+':'+original)
    target=out/destination
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    target.write_bytes(data)
    target.chmod(0o444)
    provenance.append({'category':category,'repository':str(repo),'revision':selector or 'staged index over '+base,'original_path':original,'artifact':str(target),'git_blob':git('rev-parse', selector+':'+original).decode().strip(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'original_lines':[1,len(data.splitlines())],'omitted_or_redacted':'none'})
    return str(target)
for f in ['client.py','tests/test_client.py']:
    candidate.append(materialize('',f,'candidate','candidate/'+f))
    historical.append(materialize(base,f,'review base','base/'+f))
historical.append(materialize(release,'provider/settings.py','compatibility baseline','eval-release/provider/settings.py'))
for f in ['README.md','docs/feat/wip/enhanced-settings/design.md','docs/feat/wip/enhanced-settings/implementation.md','docs/feat/wip/enhanced-settings/tasks.md']:
    context.append(materialize('',f,'intent/context','candidate/'+f))
patch=out/'staged.patch'
patch.write_bytes(git('diff','--cached','--','client.py','tests/test_client.py'))
patch.chmod(0o444)
prov=out/'provenance.json'
prov.write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2)+'\\n')
prov.chmod(0o444)
change_context = f'''# Change context\\n\\nExplicit user scope: staged client receipt handling, task 1 of enhanced-settings, isolated review only.\\nReview base: {base}; candidate: staged index. No unstaged changes at selection. Two changed files: client.py (+3/-1), tests/test_client.py (+1/-1).\\nCompatibility baseline: eval-release at {release}; actual provider source from provider/settings.py is materialized with provenance. This is a source-level comparison, not a deployed-state claim.\\nAuthority: README.md requires every merged client increment to support released provider eval-release, ordinary saves included with enhanced_settings=False. Successful saves require both applied values and caller success. Independent client/provider shipment required. No live environment available or required.\\nIntent: task 1 adds client application-receipt handling and its unit test. Provider receipt implementation is pending task 2.\\nExisting entry point: save_settings(send, workspace_id, values, enhanced_settings=False). Transport is caller-injected; historical provider defines update_settings(storage, workspace_id, request).\\nNo execution results are claimed in this initial evidence package. Parent read all materialized sources and selected diff; Capy searches for review findings and Python idioms returned empty knowledge base. No concrete rejected approaches were supplied.\\n\\n## Task Scope\\nReview mode: mid-implementation\\nIn scope: Task 1 Client receipt handling — done, user explicitly selected; client.py and tests/test_client.py.\\nOut of scope: Task 2 Provider receipts — pending, separate provider repository. Do not flag this pending implementation as missing. Pending work does not excuse current regressions or incompatibility under the shared delivery contract.\\n\\n## Profile routing and loading\\nAll eight detection rules read; python matches .py extension for both selected files. go/java/js_ts/kotlin/k8s/k8s-operator do not match file predicates. skill-md does not match: no ancestor SKILL.md in repository. No content-based routing was needed. All four Python review checklists are always-load. Bootstrap packet parts 1–6, profile index packet part 1, checklist packet parts 1–2 read completely by parent before investigation.\\n\\n## Review questions\\nTrace candidate success/failure behavior and caller-visible results through actual supported-provider source, including ordinary flag-off saves. Compare review-base behavior to attribute introduced versus inherited issues. Verify the staged test's scenario against required compatibility. Respect task 2 boundary without assuming it changes current baseline. Apply all supplied criteria.\\n'''
ctx=out/'change-context.md'
ctx.write_text(change_context)
ctx.chmod(0o444)
manifest={'instructions':criteria,'diff':[str(patch)],'candidate_source':candidate,'historical_source':historical,'historical_provenance':[str(prov)],'intent_context':context+[str(ctx)],'external_reviewer_status':'PAL tools/listmodels unavailable in current tool inventory; proceeding with isolated code-reviewer only.'}
manifest['all_paths'] = [p for key in ['instructions','diff','candidate_source','historical_source','historical_provenance','intent_context'] for p in manifest[key]]
assert set(criteria).issubset(manifest['all_paths'])
manifest_file=out/'manifest.json'
manifest_file.write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
manifest_file.chmod(0o444)
print(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
PY"
